Email service: daily challenge, 2026-12-10

The shared System Designer challenge for 2026-12-10: Email service. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Mail arrives from the whole internet, including a lot of spam, and must land in the right inbox. People open, search, send and attach. Never lose a message, and keep search fast even over years of mail.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
